The present application filed under Section 430 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (formerly Section 389 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973) seeks suspension of sentence awarded to the Applicant vide order on sentence dated 19 th December, 2024 passed by ASJ (SC-POCSO)-02, West District, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi in Sessions Case No. 595/2017, titled State v. Sonu, during the pendency of the accompanying appeal.
